A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same PartDiffuser research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C. Pages 2–13 have identical extracted text and rendered images. Page 1 differs only in an author's displayed name and the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v3 reports original mesh-generation comparisons in Table 1, conditioning ablations in Table 2, efficiency measurements in Table 3, and segmentation-robustness results in Appendix C.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark comparisons, conditioning ablations, efficiency measurements, and appendix robustness results reported in v3.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain identical segmentation, tokenization, hierarchical conditioning, attention mechanisms, diffusion objectives, and semi-autoregressive training and sampling procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions train on filtered Objaverse and 3DFront data and evaluate point-cloud-to-mesh generation on Objaverse, HSSD, and 3DFront. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 evaluates the same baselines: MeshAnythingV2, BPT, and TreeMeshGPT. The conditioning variants in Table 2 and the PartField/SAMPart3D comparison in Appendix C.1 also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported protocols are identical, including 300 test samples per dataset, the appendix's 9:1:1 data split, CD/HD/EMD/F1 metrics, model and block sizes, training budgets, and ablation and sampling settings.

E4.justification: The hierarchical-conditioning ablations, acceleration-factor analysis, segmentation-robustness experiment, and sampling-process case studies are unchanged in Sections 4.4–4.5 and Appendix C.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same reporting practices: numerical scores and average inference latencies without reported repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 and the appendix findings are identical. For example, Table 1 retains Objaverse CD × 10^3 of 17.813 and F1 of 0.343 for PartDiffuser; Table 3 retains default inference latency of 63.8 seconds.

T1.justification: The attention equations, likelihood factorization, and diffusion objective in Section 3.3, together with the cluster-count definitions in Appendix A, are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about combining global structural consistency with local geometric fidelity through part-wise diffusion and outperforming existing mesh-generation methods.

C2.justification: The explanations of conditioning benefits, sampling behavior, segmentation robustness, and speed–quality tradeoffs are identical. Section 5.1 retains the same limitations concerning model capacity, context length, sampling efficiency, and dependence on upstream segmentation.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices A–B retain the same filtering and augmentation instructions, hardware, training durations, noise schedules, attention-mask details, and sampling pseudocode. No code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 46 bibliography entries are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to autoregressive mesh generation, part-level generation, and discrete diffusion.

P1.justification: The first-page author name changes from 'Linin Yang' to 'Linlin Yang'. The arXiv stamp changes from v3 dated 16 May 2026 to v4 dated 30 July 2026. The prose and document structure are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Only the first-page layout changes slightly: the author line is recentered and the vertical arXiv stamp is repositioned. Figures 1–9, Tables 1–3, Algorithm 1, and all remaining page layouts are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v4 changes an author's displayed spelling and the version/date stamp, with minor first-page layout effects. The scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendices are unchanged, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
